patch.value: GH-787: workspace snapshot and restore primitives for cheap reproducible evaluation episodes

Provide a supported workspace-level snapshot boundary for agent benchmarks, eval suites, and A/B episodes. Today harnesses must delete and re-seed the complete workspace because item restore and operation-local rollback checkpoints do not capture a whole project. Define authoritative versus derived/transient state and add content-addressed create/restore primitives, or an equivalently complete public SDK contract, so repeated episodes reset safely without stale indexes, copied locks, or hidden external state.

The authoritative workspace snapshot boundary is explicitly versioned and documented, including item files, histories, schemas, extension state, derived indexes, locks, caches, and machine-local state; public SDK and CLI primitives create, inspect, list, restore, and delete named or content-addressed snapshots atomically; restore invalidates or rebuilds derived state and never revives stale locks; unchanged snapshots deduplicate content; repeated evaluation episodes restore faster than full re-seeding at realistic scale; crash safety, cross-version compatibility, multi-branch behavior, security boundaries, and packed installed-consumer tests pass
